prior_summary: Hole-frame SE(3) Cartesian diffusion makes alignment, descent, insertion, and hold targets equivariant to the currently observed hole pose while retaining robot reachability features.
applicable_conditions: Prefer for a translated or rotated but reachable hole when the peg is securely closed-grasped, clear of the box, and already near axis alignment. Resolve the destination pose from the current observation at each replan and execution step.
termination_guidance: Do not terminate from model diagnostics. Use the unchanged task success evaluator: supplied head-x interval, y/z tolerance, minimum axis alignment, and stable held pose.
limitations: Equivariance does not imply reachability or collision freedom. Training has one fixture pose and nominal successes only, with no contact truth, drop recovery, jam retry, or large-error recovery.
